name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted vanity?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding vanities sit directly on the floor, resembling a piece of furniture. They are generally easier to install as they don't require wall-mounting and often provide more storage capacity. Wall-mounted vanities, also known as floating vanities, are attached to the wall, leaving the floor underneath clear. This can create a more modern, spacious feel and simplify cleaning the bathroom floor. The choice depends on aesthetic preference, available space, and specific installation requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding vanities sit on the floor, offering easier installation and more storage. Wall-mounted vanities attach to the wall, creating a modern look and easier floor cleaning.
